newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Xuanzhi Paper to issue A shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Xuanzhi Paper to issue A shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: Anhui Hongxing Xuanzhi Paper Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it would issue 15.30 million class A shares and 1.70 million employee shares to be listed on the Shenzhen stock exchange.

The issue, approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission and priced at 5.88 yuan per share, would start on September 19 and should be completed by September 27, Hongxing said in an offer prospectus in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Anhui International Trust and Investment Co had been named main underwriter, Hongxing said.
The A shares will be listed in Shenzhen, with the employee shares floated six months after the class A stock, it said.
Following the offer of the A shares and employee shares, Hongxing's total share capital would rise to 50 million shares, including 33 million state-owned shares, it said.
Hongxing said it aimed to channel proceeds from the offers into its core business, making paper used for Chinese painting and calligraphy.
The company has forecast after-tax profits of 15.97 million yuan for 1996, compared with 11.32 million yuan a year earlier and 9.04 million yuan in 1994.
Hongxing said it had posted 3.93 million yuan in net earnings in the first five months of this year. It did not give comparative figures.
About 80 percent of Hongxing's paper products are exported to Japan, South Korea and Hong Kong, with the remaining 20 percent sold domestically, the prospectus said.
